name: OrthoHarness
summary: OrthoHarness now lives at decisionindex.com: the orthopaedic check (a topic against JBJS by level of evidence; an AI answer's citations and quotes against PubMed, by fixed rules, nothing stored) is the draft orthopaedic set at decisionindex.com/ortho. The OrthoHarness name and tool are available to acquire or license (white-label) for orthopaedic device and AI makers validating their AI.

actions.label: Check an orthopaedic topic, or an AI answer's citations, at decisionindex.com/ortho (runs in the browser straight to PubMed; nothing stored)
Acquire or license the OrthoHarness name and tool (white-label for orthopaedic device and AI makers)
